discovered_temporal_laws.law_name: Long-Range Sleep Dart Penalty under Active Dive Threat
discovered_temporal_laws.description: Expending Sleep Dart as long-range poke early or mid-fight when enemy comps contain dive threats (Tracer, Genji, Doomfist, Sombra) directly causes player deaths and fight losses due to cooldown unavailability during target engagement.

supporting_evidence.context: Player used sleep:long_range_poke early at 01:43 against enemy dive comp; sleep was on cooldown when dove at 02:32, resulting in player death and fight loss.
Player fired long-range poke sleep dart down main corridor at 00:41; taken down by enemy close-range engage at 00:49 with sleep on CD.

discovered_temporal_laws.description: Delaying offensive Anti-Nade until mid/late fight sequence during active frontline engagement yields 100% win rate in GM cohorts compared to early uncoordinated engagement nades.

supporting_evidence.context: After stabilizing with defensive heal at 00:52, mid-fight offensive nade at 01:06 into frontline cluster secured fight victory.
Mid-fight offensive anti-nade on warehouse stairs cluster at 05:14 followed Nano engage to win fight.

discovered_temporal_laws.law_name: First-Action Neutral Anti-Nade Trap without Dive Threat
discovered_temporal_laws.description: Throwing an offensive anti-nade as the very first action in neutral 5v5 state without active dive threats yields an abnormally low 20% win rate and 40% death rate due to wasted utility prior to main engagement.

supporting_evidence.context: First action offensive nade into doorway at 00:46 led to player death at 01:16 and fight loss.
Opening with offensive nade into doorway led to loss and player death at 02:59.

discovered_temporal_laws.description: Using Biotic Grenade for self/ally stabilization when entering numbers disadvantage at low/critical HP (<120 HP) converts potential wipes into fight recoveries.

supporting_evidence.context: At 4v5 deficit and taking burst damage, immediate nade:self_heal stabilized player, leading to full fight turnaround.
At 4v5 deficit with 112 HP, nade:self_heal sustained Ana and Mauga, enabling a 1.0 win rate outcome.
At 4v5 deficit with 53 HP, nade:self_heal allowed survival against flanker and won fight.

discovered_temporal_laws.law_name: Snowball Nano-Boost Ult Chaining under Numbers Advantage
discovered_temporal_laws.description: Deploying Nano Boost in mid/late fight sequence immediately after securing a numbers advantage (5v4 or better) guarantees 100% fight conversion.

supporting_evidence.context: Nano Boost on Mauga in 5v4 state at 02:20 closed out the fight cleanly.
Nano Boost on D.Va in 5v4 state at 02:58 guaranteed full wipe.
Nano Boost on Winston in 5v4 advantage at 02:17 converted fight victory.

contextual_interaction_laws.context_factor: Enemy Threat Profile (Dive Threat vs Non-Dive Poke)
contextual_interaction_laws.finding: Against compositions with high dive threat (Tracer, Genji, Doomfist, Sombra, Venture), offensive anti-nade requires defensive holding of Sleep Dart for close targets. Attempting long-range sleep dart drops Ana's win rate to 0.0% because dive heroes exploit the 14-second window. In contrast, against low dive compositions (e.g. Roadhog/Orisa poke), close/mid sleep darts can be used proactively to set up frontline kills.
contextual_interaction_laws.empirical_pattern: GM players against dive threats hold sleep for target engagement under 15m (0.833 win rate in Diamond, 0.667 in GM), whereas long-range sleep dart against dive comps results in 0.0% win rate across all ranks.

contextual_interaction_laws.context_factor: Sequence Timing (First Action vs Mid/Late Fight)
contextual_interaction_laws.finding: Opening a fight with an offensive anti-nade before team engagement occurs leads to wasted utility (0.20 win rate in neutral non-dive setups). Mid-fight anti-nades delivered once frontlines bind yield a 1.00 win rate in GM cohorts because Kiriko Suzu or defensive abilities are already baited or enemy positions are anchored.
contextual_interaction_laws.empirical_pattern: mid_or_late_fight_action nade:offensive_anti (1.00 win rate, 0% death rate in GM) vs first_action_in_fight nade:offensive_anti (0.20 win rate, 40% death rate in Diamond).

rules.discovered_pattern_name: Anti-Poke Sleep Dart Prohibition under Dive Threat
rules.optimal_action_vs_fatal_action: OPTIMAL: Hold sleep dart for close/mid target (<15m) or defensive peel. FATAL: Action (sleep:long_range_poke).
rules.empirical_evidence_from_dataset: Long-range sleep poke under dive threat produces 0.0% fight win rate and 50% player death rate (Replays: 0AJTQ5 fight 2, Q9KEG8 fight 1, HSA58Z fight 1).
rules.coaching_trigger: Player uses Sleep Dart at long range (>25m) while enemy team runs Tracer/Genji/Sombra/Doomfist.

rules.optimal_action_vs_fatal_action: OPTIMAL: Action (nade:offensive_anti) into engaged frontline clusters. FATAL: Opening fight with uncoordinated long-range anti-nade prior to frontline contact.
rules.empirical_evidence_from_dataset: Mid-fight offensive nades achieve 100% fight win rate and 0% death rate in GM trajectories (0AJTQ5 fight 1, HSA58Z fight 4) compared to 20% win rate for uncoordinated opening nades (V89RSK fight 1 & 2).
rules.coaching_trigger: Player throws Biotic Grenade at start of fight before tanks engage.

rules.optimal_action_vs_fatal_action: OPTIMAL: Action (nade:self_heal) targeting self and nearby allies. FATAL: Attempting greedy offensive anti-nade or holding nade while dying.
rules.empirical_evidence_from_dataset: Self-heal nade during numbers disadvantage at low HP results in 100% win rate and 0% player death rate (CP9GCK fight 1, D86HQF fight 2, HZJK6E fight 1, NX415N fight 1).
rules.coaching_trigger: Player drops below 120 HP during deficit state without using Biotic Grenade defensively.

rules.optimal_action_vs_fatal_action: OPTIMAL: Action (ult_on:Tank/Brawler) to rapidly wipe remaining enemy team. FATAL: Holding ultimate until enemy team regroups or resets.
rules.empirical_evidence_from_dataset: Nano Boost deployed during 5v4 or 5v3 advantage yields a 100% fight win rate across Diamond and GM cohorts (D86HQF fight 2 & 3, CP9GCK fight 2, MFTXPE fight 2 & 4).
rules.coaching_trigger: Player holds Nano Boost for more than 10 seconds after team achieves first pick.
